text: Priscilla Ferreira is a Staff Frontend Engineer at NexaTech Solutions, bringing a decade of experience in building scalable, user-centric web applications within the SaaS industry. Her work focuses on architecting and maintaining high-performance frontend systems that drive seamless user experiences. With a strong emphasis on React and TypeScript, she has shaped the company’s frontend architecture, mentoring teams and leading initiatives that enhance code reliability and maintainability. Priscilla’s expertise in Next.js has enabled the development of critical enterprise applications, including a dashboard suite that reduced page load times by 40% through optimized routing and data fetching strategies. She owns the company’s design system, which has standardized UI components across 12 products, improving development velocity and consistency. Her contributions to web performance optimization—such as implementing lazy loading and critical path rendering—have directly impacted user engagement metrics. Priscilla also leverages Webpack and Vite to streamline build processes, ensuring rapid iteration without compromising quality. Beyond technical leadership, she collaborates closely with product and design teams to align technical solutions with business goals, ensuring her work remains both innovative and strategically aligned.
